name: Al Waratheh
overview: A meeting that brings the Brotherhood together again..! The events of the series revolve around the death of the head of a family, leaving a lot of money and real estate for his children, but he stipulated in his will the meeting of his children and grandchildren in one house for three months, so that each of them has a share in this estate, and when they meet according to the will, the differences begin to appear on the surface, taking multiple forms and work to divide the brothers and divide them into parties, each of which works against the interests of the other.
